Interface AutofocusManager

public interface AutofocusManager
This entity provides access to methods for controlling autofocus of the microscope. You can access it via Studio.getAutofocusManager().

  • Method Details

    • setAutofocusMethod

      void setAutofocusMethod(AutofocusPlugin plugin)
      Set the current AutofocusPlugin to use for performing autofocus actions.
      Parameters:
      plugin - AutofocusPlugin to use for autofocus.

    • setAutofocusMethodByName

      void setAutofocusMethodByName(String name)
      Set the current AutofocusPlugin by name. This will throw an IllegalArgumentException if there is no AutofocusPlugin with the specified name (as per the value returned by its getName() method).
      Parameters:
      name - Name of autofocus method to use.

    • getAutofocusMethod

      AutofocusPlugin getAutofocusMethod()
      Return the current AutofocusPlugin being used to run autofocus. It is recommended that callers invoke this method whenever the current autofocus plugin is required, rather than storing its results.
      Returns:
      AutofocusPlugin currently selected.

    • getAllAutofocusMethods

      List<String> getAllAutofocusMethods()
      Return a list of the current valid autofocus names, suitable for use in setAutofocusMethodByName(). This includes both software AutofocusPlugins (which are accessible via the PluginManager) and hardware autofocus devices (which are not).
      Returns:
      List of valid autofocus names.

    • refresh

      void refresh()
      Update the list of available autofocus devices by scanning the system for autofocus device adapters and AutofocusPlugins.

    • initialize

      void initialize()
      Initializes all known autofocus plugins.
